standard.title: Numbers 100–1,000,000
standard.explanation: Large numbers in French follow specific rules. 'Cent' (100) takes an 's' in the plural only when not followed by another number: 'deux cents' (200) but 'deux cent trente' (230). 'Mille' (1000) never takes an 's' in any form: 'mille', 'deux mille', 'dix mille'. 'Million' and 'milliard' take an 's' in the plural and are followed by 'de' before a noun: 'un million d'euros', 'deux millions de personnes'. Always count: 100=cent, 200=deux cents, 300=trois cents, 1000=mille, 2000=deux mille.

advanced.title: Numbers 100–1,000,000 — cent/mille Agreement, Pronunciation & Usage
advanced.explanation: Large numbers require careful attention to agreement rules. 'Cent' (100) takes an 's' only when it stands alone as a plural (deux cents = 200) but loses the 's' when followed by another number (deux cent trente = 230). 'Mille' (1000) is invariable and never takes an 's' in any position: mille, deux mille, dix mille, etc. 'Million' and 'milliard' (billion) are count nouns that pluralize (deux millions, trois milliards) and require 'de' before a following noun: un million de gens, deux milliards d'habitants. When speaking prices or large quantities, numbers are pronounced fully: trois cent quarante-cinq euros (345 euros), deux mille vingt-six (2026).

standard.scenario: Tell someone how much things typically cost where you live.
standard.modelAnswer: Une maison coûte environ deux cent mille euros où je vis. Une voiture coûte mille euros ou plus. Un repas au restaurant coûte vingt-cinq euros. C'est assez cher!
standard.modelAnswerExplanation: This response gives realistic prices for common items using large numbers correctly (with proper agreement for cent and mille).
standard.tip: Use 'environ' (approximately) for estimates. Remember cent takes -s only when plural without another number (deux cents), while mille never does (deux mille, not 'deux milles').

advanced.scenario: Discuss housing prices and other major expenses in your area.
keyPhrases: Il y a des millions de...
advanced.modelAnswer: Un appartement coûte environ quatre cent mille euros. Une maison coûte un million ou deux millions. Il y a des millions de gens dans ma région. Les prix augmentent chaque année. C'est devenu très cher pour les jeunes!
advanced.modelAnswerExplanation: This response uses multiple large numbers correctly, provides context about price trends, and reflects on the social impact of housing costs.
advanced.tip: Use agreements: 'deux cents' (200) but 'deux cent mille' (200,000); 'deux mille' never changes (2,000, 20,000); 'deux millions' pluralizes with 'de'. Include comparative language like 'plus cher', 'moins cher', 'augmente' to enrich discussion.
